newsitem.title: USA: Phymatrix in pact to develop facilities.
newsitem.headline: Phymatrix in pact to develop facilities.

text.p: PhyMatrix Corp said on Wednesday that it has agreed to an exclusive arrangement with North Shore Health System of Manhasset, New York, to develop, own, and operate medical facilities in five metropolitan New York counties.
The companies said they plan to invest about $500 million in the venture in the next five years.

Under the terms of the letter of intent, PhyMatrix and the the not-for-profit health system will develop, own, and manage medical malls, medical office buildings, senior clinics, skilled nursing facilities and other related medical facilities in Nassau, Suffolk, Queens, Kings, and Richmond counties in New York.
PhyMatrix is a management company headquartered in West Palm Beach, Florida.
